object.description: 当某个公司没有任何 queued/running run，但存在已分配给 Agent 的 todo issue 时，watchdog 兜底派发一次（每 Agent 每 tick 最多一次，最多 10 次），不覆盖已有 run；派发记账失败不得把一次成功派发记成 skipped。
object.name: 空闲 Agent watchdog（无活跃 run 时派发已分配的 todo）

testcases.description: GIVEN a company with an assigned todo issue and no active run, WHEN the idle watchdog ticks, THEN it enqueues one wakeup with reason idle_watchdog; GIVEN a queued/running run for that company, WHEN it ticks again, THEN it skips. A failed activity write must not turn the dispatch into a skip.
testcases.name: Watchdog dispatches once, then yields to the active run
